name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Website Marketing, SEO & Conversion Optimization
summary: Website and digital growth marketer with 15+ years across MarTech, e-commerce, agency, and B2B SaaS, including 4 years of hands-on SEO. Owns the full website conversion path: technical SEO audits and schema implementation, landing pages and CRO, GA4 and Google Tag Manager setup, and CRM and marketing-automation integrations behind lead capture. At Wix, contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment. Builds LLM-based workflows daily, bringing a practical view of how AI systems read and surface content.

Identify and implement schema and structured data as part of every technical SEO audit, including full on-page schema implementation.
Install and configure Google Tag Manager on every site built, and implement GA4 tracking directly in client site HTML/CSS.
Architected lead capture, routing, and qualification flows across 20+ SMS and email automation workflows, integrated through Zapier, Make, and n8n.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut spam leads and improve click quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Claim and optimize Google Business Profile listings as the first deliverable for every client, the base of each local SEO program.
Build performance dashboards tracking traffic, funnel progression, and conversion, and present recommendations backed by the data.
